info.name: Restful Booker API Tests
info.description:
Restful Booker API tests (TC-001-TC-042).

Run the whole collection from the top: folder order matters. The token and
bookingId are produced on the happy path, the authorization negatives run
before DELETE, and folder 08 removes every booking created by the negative
cases so the shared sandbox stays clean.

Test data (names, dates) is generated per run by the collection pre-request
script, so the suite is repeatable and never depends on hard-coded dates.

https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com/apidoc/index.html

// folder "08 Cleanup" so the sandbox is not polluted by every CI run.
